Example functional enrichment results (simulated)

Source: R/data.R
example_enrichment.Rd

A small, simulated clusterProfiler-style GO over-representation table provided as ready-to-use example data for the enrichmentDotPlotServer() module. Enrichment terms are tested across two gene clusters, mimicking the output of clusterProfiler::compareCluster().

Usage

data(example_enrichment)

Format

A data frame with 14 rows and 10 columns:

Cluster

Gene cluster the term was enriched in ("Upregulated" or "Downregulated"); used for the dot plot x-axis

ONTOLOGY

GO ontology ("BP")

ID

GO term identifier

Description

Human-readable enrichment term; used for the dot plot y-axis

GeneRatio

Fraction of query genes in the term, as a "count/total" string; parsed to a numeric ratio for dot size

BgRatio

Fraction of background genes in the term, as a "count/total" string

pvalue

Over-representation p-value

p.adjust

Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value

qvalue

q-value

Count

Number of query genes in the term

Source

Simulated in data-raw/generate_example_enrichment.R; no real biological data are included.

Author

Jacob Martin

Examples

library(sciVizModules)
data(example_enrichment)
head(example_enrichment)
#>       Cluster ONTOLOGY         ID                         Description GeneRatio
